title: rich result record (v1)
description: One vertical block of a rich callback response as one JSONL result record: the vertical's own upstream member name as its bucket, the vertical's zero-based ordinal among the response's vertical blocks, and its whole item count. The record is deliberately per block, not per item, because the upstream response shape is undocumented: the vertical block is the largest unit this CLI can name without modeling internals it cannot verify, and the lossless items stay in the JSON envelope's data.upstream.

bucket.$comment: The vertical block's own upstream member name.

position.$comment: The vertical's zero-based ordinal among the response's vertical blocks, in document order.

item_count.$comment: The vertical block's whole array size, counting non-object elements too.
